name: Monly
tagline: Monly is an awesome budget planner
blurb: Monly is an awesome budget planner.
description:
Monly is an awesome budget planner. It supports transactions logging,
budgets, reports, synchronization across your devices and a lot of other features.
Monly is distributed so every device has its own copy of data. You may loose
a device, but not your data.
